body.x: Fugoo(fugoo.com) showcased 'fugoo jacket' at 'Showstoppers' of the '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show that is being held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
Company explained "Jackets are interchangeable and are easily installed over the robust core. It fits your active life style like the ball fits the hoop"

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
